papers.title: Tilting Modules for Reductive Algebraic Groups: Characters and Support Varieties
papers.license: SIAM edition: CC BY 4.0, International Mathematical Union 2026; arXiv copy: non-exclusive distribution license

coverage.read: All mathematical body, pp.1-23, sections 1-3.6. Bibliography inspected selectively, not all cited papers independently read.
integrated: Sections 2.1-2.3: weights/root data, induced/Weyl/simple/tilting modules, tensor closure, Weyl character formula, SL2 example.
Sections 2.4-2.5: dot action, linkage, orbit decomposition route, facets and strong representatives, translation, singular multiplicities and a coefficient-comparison proof.

Sections 2.6-2.7: Hecke algebra, p-canonical coefficients via parity stalks (with supplementary background), all-primes Theorem 2.6 with C_J nonempty, antispherical proof route, pointwise large-characteristic stability.
coverage.proof_status: 018P is a complete deduction conditional on the stated translation theorem. 018K and 018V are explicitly limited proof routes. Deep geometric proofs are not reconstructed.

integrated: §3.1 support foundations, ordinary/relative distinction, annihilator and localization properties, finite-generation interface, mu_p and projective/trivial examples.
§3.2.3 set-versus-scheme support illustrated by an explicit thickening; SL2 p>2 as a conditional nilpotent-cone interface.
deepening.proof_status: Elementary commutative-algebra proofs and explicit mu_p calculation are complete. General cohomological support consequences are full deductions conditional on named action/finite-generation inputs; nilpotent-cone identification is not proved.

limitations: Sections 2.8-2.9, including simple-character formulas and Finkelberg-Mirkovic equivalences, read but not integrated.
Section 3 is now partially integrated through §§3.1 and 3.2.3 foundations; Humphreys orbit formulas, Lusztig-Vogan, co-t-structures, tensor ideals and general geometric proofs remain unintegrated.
Geometric Satake, Smith-Treumann and Koszul-duality constructions are named inputs to a proof route, not independently constructed or proved.
Williamson 2018 is supplementary background only, never a substitute for the exact ICM2026 report.

New support branch distinguishes ordinary ring support, cohomological support and relative support. Finite-generation and central-action inputs, and SL2 p>2 ring identification, remain explicitly external.

papers.title: On Geometric Models in Representation Theory
papers.license: SIAM edition: CC BY 4.0, International Mathematical Union 2026; arXiv copy: non-exclusive distribution license

coverage.read: All mathematical body, pp.1-17, sections 1-9. Bibliography pp.17-21 inspected selectively, not all cited papers independently read.
integrated: Section 2: quivers, paths/relations, Morita equivalence, gentle axioms without implicit finite-dimensionality, grading, infinite example, quadratic dual and local proof.

Sections 3-4.3: ribbon graphs and dissections; dg/finite-cohomology/perfect/proper/smooth distinctions; dual-numbers counterexample with full projective-resolution proof; line fields, grading, local systems, curve classification and spiral completion.
Section 4.4: cone matrix, single-basis-morphism crossing theorem and cancellation proof route with zero/closed-curve caveats.

Sections 6.1 and 7.1/7.4: exceptional sequences and connected-surface existence criterion, silting, smooth graded-gentle derived invariant, two-direction proof route; graded derived-closure open question from section 2.
coverage.proof_status: 0199 and 019I are full elementary verifications. 019T and 019Y are proof routes, not complete geometric classification proofs.

integrated: §8.1 elementary Hochschild prerequisites: ordinary bimodules, bar resolution with contraction, cochains, HH0 and HH1.
§8.2 ordinary first-order associative deformation specialization: associativity, gauge, normalization, HH2 classification, dual-number calculations and second-order extension/obstruction examples.
deepening.proof_status: New bar/low-degree/first-order proofs and examples are complete in the ordinary ungraded setting over any field. Full graded surface deformation/classification is not reconstructed.

limitations: Advanced categorical statements conservatively assume an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, matching the report's global safe convention.
Full Fukaya A-infinity, recollement, Serre entropy, braid nontransitivity, presilting noncompletion and no-silting classification not reconstructed.

Sections 8-9 are now partially integrated only through ordinary Hochschild and first-order associative deformation foundations. Full TT calculus, graded/A-infinity and orbifold/semi-gentle extensions remain unintegrated.
019X retains homological smoothness and uses perfect dg derived categories, not bounded categories of all modules.
No claim of exhaustive proof coverage or whole-forest semantic review.
New elementary Hochschild calculations work in arbitrary characteristic; this does not relax the characteristic-zero assumptions on old advanced geometric statements.

complete_proofs.scope: Proves theorem 01K2: both directions Supp(E)=V(Ann E) using a product of finitely many denominators; no Noether assumption.
Elementwise exactness of localization and union formula for a short exact sequence of ordinary R-modules.
Annihilator localization for finite modules; primewise localization-of-support identification.
Q/Z counterexample, including annihilator, all local supports and failure of annihilator localization.
R/(x^2) computes set support and failure of scheme-theoretic support on R/(x).
Explicit dual Hopf algebra of mu_p is k^p; computes strict ordinary/relative support difference without deep support classification.
Finite-dimensionality of the Frobenius-kernel coordinate quotient via bounded monomials; uses existing affine group-scheme/Hopf definitions.
General graded-ring lemma: homogeneous annihilator and scaling-stable support. Its cohomological application is separately conditional.
Cancellation of face maps proves bar differential squares to zero.
Proves theorem 01L2: free Ae-module terms and explicit k-linear contracting homotopy of the augmented bar complex.
Explicit Hom(bar,M) identification proves differential formula and computes Ext using the existing Ext foundations.
HH0 equals the center by kernel and absence of negative cochains.
HH1 equals derivations modulo inner derivations, all characteristics.
Proves theorem 01L9: full associator expansion and D-trilinearity give necessity and sufficiency.
Both directions of gauge equivalence nu=mu-delta f with inverse id-epsilon f.
Complete low-degree normalization, including surjectivity and injectivity onto ordinary HH2.
Complete classification of fixed-unit, fixed-free-module first-order associative deformations, assembled from three fully proved elementary lemmas.
All derivations of k[x]/(x^2) and characteristic-two jump in HH1.
All normalized 2-cocycles and 2-coboundaries of k[x]/(x^2), giving full HH2 in every characteristic.
Free rank-two first-order quotient, exact gauge parameters and explicit compatible higher-order extensions by a monic relation.
Full second-order associator coefficient calculation; not a claim of complete HH3 obstruction theory.
Explicit non-boundary 2-cocycle on a four-dimensional square-zero algebra and contradiction to second-order extension.
